replacements.Alucinación interna → acción irreversibl: Internal hallucination → irreversible action and infinite loop
replacements.Cuando el sistema actúa, una alucinación: When the system acts, an internal perceptual hallucination has different consequences from an incorrect response. The agentic infinite loop is a structural variant of the same problem.
replacements.El modelo genera una representación inco: The model generates an incorrect representation: "green traffic light" when it is red, "empty form" when it contains data.
replacements.Lógica coherente con la percepción errón: Logic coherent with the incorrect perception
replacements.Las inferencias son válidas dado el esta: The inferences are valid given the perceived state. The original error goes unnoticed.
replacements.Herramienta ejecutada sobre estado equiv: Tool executed on the wrong state
replacements.Rellena el formulario borrando datos pre: It fills the form while deleting previous data, advances the process in the wrong state, and submits the record with incorrect data.
replacements.Fallo sin traza de causa: Failure with no trace of the cause
replacements.Los logs muestran percepción → razonamie: The logs show perception → reasoning → action, all apparently correct. The origin of the error is never recorded.
replacements.Registro modificado, proceso avanzado, d: Record modified, process advanced, data sent
replacements.Puede no ser reversible. Afecta a tercer: It may not be reversible. It affects third parties.
replacements.Estructura del bucle infinito agéntico: Structure of the agentic infinite loop
replacements.Estado post-acción interpretado con prio: Post-action state interpreted with a biased prior
replacements.\"El estado sigue sin ser el correcto, r: "The state is still not correct, so I repeat the action"
replacements.Acción que no cambia el estado de forma: An action that does not change the state in a detectable way
replacements.Por qué el ciclo no termina: Why the cycle does not end
replacements.El modelo percibe el resultado de la acc: The model perceives the action result consistently with its prior expectations: every time it acts, it "confirms" that the state is still wrong because its perception of the post-action state is biased in the same way as its pre-action perception. The cycle reinforces itself.
replacements.El sistema no tiene un máximo de pasos d: The system has no defined maximum number of steps. It can repeat the action indefinitely until it exhausts resources (time, tokens, API calls).
replacements.El modelo no puede distinguir entre \"el: The model cannot distinguish between "the state did not change" and "I perceived the change incorrectly". Both produce the same internal representation.
replacements.Sin supervisión humana en el loop: No human supervision in the loop
replacements.Si el ciclo observar-actuar es completam: If the observe-act cycle is fully autonomous, there is no point where a human can interrupt before the system exhausts its resources or causes accumulated harm.
replacements.Verificación de cambio de estado antes d: Verify state change before repeating an action
replacements.Log de estado diferencial (qué cambió re: Differential state log (what actually changed between steps)
